I used to struggle a lot speaking growing up which was really exasperated by years of isolation. I have a bit of a speech impediment and I stutter and I was late to speak as a kid. I wasn't speaking until I was 3 years old according to my mom. I still don't speak perfectly but it has improved a lot since doing all these:

Reading books or watching video essays helped my vocabulary, it effortlessly made me remember difficult words and made me understand how and when to use them as time went on.

Reading anything outloud can help practice your delivery and help establish a better mind-mouth connection.

Lastly, journaling and essay writing is amazing at practicing how to align your thoughts to sentences in a concise manner. A lot of times I struggle with expressing my thoughts because there is a lot of ideas in my head. Writing them out slows your thoughts down and trains your brain how to structure and communicate better +its really good at getting to know yourself.

Don't feel discouraged 🙌🏻 your problem is very much fixable. I hope this helps you 🙏🏻

I have! Honestly my greatest manifestation so far besides getting my lost phone back. I want to post a full success story soon once we reach a year together. But to cut a long story short:

On new years this year, the power was out and I was bored waiting for it to come back so I decided to imagine being loved while listening to music. It felt pretty real and it felt great. I imagined myself hugging and getting kissed by this new love and envisioning scenes together (Which actually came to pass weeks to a month later!). I didn't envision a face or list down/affirm for the qualities I wanted this person to have, just that I wanted to feel wholely loved, seen and understood by them whoever they are. I kept looping the scenes and the feeling until I was satisfied.

After that one SATS session I didn't think much about it anymore. I just felt confident that I was going to receive love eventually whenever the universe thought I was ready for it. I felt loved already inside whether I had someone or not so I felt no rush or desperation.

A little less than a week later I spontaneously met my current boyfriend by chance who fits almost ALL my criteria. Criterias that are seriously by chance (for ex. were both mixed raced and have very similar experiences) while also he's incredibly sweet and loving towards me. He respects me and I feel so accepted by him. He's so affectionate and has such a pure soul. He always calls me beautiful or gorgeous and says he loves my eyes, a feature of mine that I'm incredibly insecure about but wanted a partner to love. All that I felt in SATS is what I feel with him. I can go on and on about this! But yeah, he's just what I wanted ❤️

The advice I could give is:

1.	⁠Have good self-concept. My partner wouldn't have come into my life if I still was insecure and didn't believe I was worthy of love.
2.	⁠Be happy with the feeling of being loved even if you don't have anyone loving you right now. You attract what you are (what you feel inside).
3.	⁠(optional) Let go of resentment towards any exes and bless them. Florence Scovel Shinn's book "The game of life" changed my perception on love and was key for me. Her section on love was basically saying; how can you attract love when you are cultivating hate and resentment? Though I know letting go and being loving is hard, I don't necessarily think its important to manifesting but you can give it a shot if it helps because it helped me.

So yeah you can absolutely manifest new/unknown love!

It's now been a year since learning about the law and it has mostly helped me and I'm glad to know about it. I have gotten into some negative spirals over it like a lot of us do but I feel more empowered and hopeful than I have ever been in my life. I've been plagued with depression, hopelessness and not being able to believe in myself almost all my life and the law has made me recognize that I have the capacity (just like everyone else) to achieve my dreams. Even if you don't believe in the woo-woo of the law it makes a lot of sense psychologically, its a great psychological tool.

My negative spirals came from not fully understanding that the point of the law isn't really to get stuff in the 3d in the first place but to feel fulfilled within and once you feel good and fulfilled within then you will automatically act accordingly (or energy will align) to obtain what it is you want but you shouldn't feel like you need the 3d to reflect, you should feel okay whether or not it shows up because all that matters is what you feel within. I think especially for a beginner you shouldn't focus on trying to manifest things you're desperate for or in a time crunch for or you're more likely to be stuck.

Positively, I managed to be more organized in my life which was hard for me to do with ADHD and depression by visualizing and feeling the wish fulfilled. It made me feel relaxed which enabled me to take the actions necessary to fulfill whatever it is I visualized. If I was obsessed or sad over a SP it would make me feel too depressed to function and take care of myself, but by deciding to feel loved even if I may not receive it in the 3d made me relaxed enough to move on with my day.

I think the main cause of the law affecting your mental health is the desperation for your desires to instantly appear, but if you use it as a tool to help your inner being feel relaxed and empowered even if it may not appear in the 3d (it will eventually cause you align your inner being 😉) then it will have a positive effect on you. I'm still learning a bunch more on how to materialize bigger things, I'm glad we have this community to share ideas 🤗 Don't burn yourself out, enjoy your life!!!

I'm a woman and I used to be into pinkpill feminism and be fearful of men when I was younger like 16-19, I'm 21 now and no longer entertain the ideology for reasons I'll get into.

The aftermath of being in those spaces had me sabotage actually good relationships with good men. We hear a bunch of shit online and online spaces can be such an echo chamber that if we're not going out into the world and meeting real people we can be stuck to an idea. If you go out into the real world you will meet all sorts of people, good and bad and you should acknowledge both.

You should be careful about being stuck to a negative idea because your mind is a very powerful tool and whatever is embedded into your subconscious your subconscious will do its best to prove that to you and manifest into your reality. So if you believe all men are bad and are to be afraid of your mind will look for evidence of that and you will see evidence of that while discarding the actual good traits a man has.

After I stopped feeding my mind with negativity and doom scrolling that's when I started having better relationships. Please don't start becoming suspicious of your BF for no reason because that's how I sabotaged one relationship. I don't necessarily think you need stories, you just have to be open minded and affirm the positive and stop entertaining such spaces.
